project_types.name: Energy efficiency upgrades
project_types.ex: Reducing energy use in existing buildings: HVAC equipment, lighting, controls and building automation, insulation, air sealing, windows, roof and envelope work, and energy assessments that identify these

project_types.name: Building electrification
project_types.ex: Replacing fossil-fuel equipment with electric: air source and ground source heat pumps, heat pump water heaters, induction cooking, and the panel and service upgrades needed to support them

project_types.name: Solar installation
project_types.ex: Customer-sited solar generation: rooftop, ground-mount and parking-canopy arrays, including solar paired with on-site storage, and the financing or incentives for them

project_types.name: Community solar
project_types.ex: Shared solar arrays that households or organizations subscribe to without hosting panels: subscriber projects, community-owned and community-driven solar, and the predevelopment for them

project_types.name: Predevelopment & soft costs
project_types.ex: Costs before construction starts: feasibility studies, engineering, legal work, site control, utility interconnection, permitting and community outreach

project_types.name: Storage & resilience
project_types.ex: Batteries and other energy storage, backup power, resilience hubs that keep services running during outages, and enrollment in virtual power plants

project_types.name: EV & fleet electrification
project_types.ex: Electric vehicles and their infrastructure: charging stations, fleet conversion, electric school and transit buses, and the depot charging needed to support them

project_types.name: Workforce & contractor capacity
project_types.ex: Building the clean energy workforce and contractor base: training, registered apprenticeships, bonding, insurance, certifications and readiness to act as a prime contractor

project_types.name: New construction & code
project_types.ex: New buildings designed to exceed the energy code: all-electric new construction, adoption of stretch energy codes, and affordable housing built to these standards

project_types.name: Planning & organizational capacity
project_types.ex: Planning and staff capacity: energy plans, benchmarking and efficiency ordinances, staffing and program administration, and community engagement

project_types.name: General capital & construction
project_types.ex: Hard costs for physical projects: construction, equipment purchase, building acquisition and improvement, paid from a grant, loan or other capital source

project_types.name: Bioenergy & biomass
project_types.ex: Energy from biological material: woody feedstock, wood processing, anaerobic digestion, renewable natural gas and biofuel production

project_types.name: Agriculture & food systems
project_types.ex: Energy and food systems on farms and in food businesses: on-farm energy, grain drying, irrigation pumping, conservation practices, and value-added processing

project_types.name: Industrial & manufacturing process
project_types.ex: Energy use inside manufacturing and industrial plants: process heat, motors and drives, compressed air, and industrial decarbonization projects

project_types.name: Wind, geothermal & district energy
project_types.ex: Wind, geothermal and district energy: distributed wind turbines, ground source heat pumps, geothermal networks and district heating and cooling systems

project_types.name: Waste, recycling & circular economy
project_types.ex: Recycling and reuse infrastructure: recycling facilities, organics diversion and composting, and materials reuse that reduces energy-intensive waste

project_types.name: Brownfield & site remediation
project_types.ex: Cleaning up contaminated land so it can host clean energy: site assessment, remediation and redevelopment of brownfield sites for solar, storage or other clean energy use

project_types.name: Freight, rail & logistics
project_types.ex: Cleaner movement of goods: rail spurs, port and intermodal infrastructure, and freight corridor improvements that reduce emissions from freight transport

project_types.name: Operating & working capital
project_types.ex: Ongoing costs that keep a project or organization running: payroll, inventory, bridging a gap between receivables and payment, and other working capital
